maker.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Bixolon, SRP-33xIII user manual, https://bixolon.com/_upload/manual/Manual_User_SRP-33xIII_ENG_V1.00.pdf

model.value: SRP-332III (203 dpi), on 2-inch paper with its partition
model.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Bixolon, SRP-33xIII user manual, https://bixolon.com/_upload/manual/Manual_User_SRP-33xIII_ENG_V1.00.pdf: “At 8 dots/mm its printing width is 72 mm on 3-inch paper and 48 mm on 2-inch paper = 384 dots”

firmware_qualified.source: Not stated by any seed source: no firmware range is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). The gate records the range it qualified (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a, §6b.5).

transport.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Bixolon, SRP-330III specification sheet, https://bixoloneu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/SS_SRP-330III_EN_JAN25_V1.pdf: “USB 2.0 FS + Ethernet + Serial”; Bixolon's command manual documents network printing on port 9100 (§4.3); TCP 9100 first, per ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a

paper_mm.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Bixolon, SRP-33xIII user manual, https://bixolon.com/_upload/manual/Manual_User_SRP-33xIII_ENG_V1.00.pdf: “48 mm on 2-inch paper = 384 dots”

dot_width.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Bixolon, SRP-33xIII user manual, https://bixolon.com/_upload/manual/Manual_User_SRP-33xIII_ENG_V1.00.pdf: “At 8 dots/mm its printing width is 72 mm on 3-inch paper and 48 mm on 2-inch paper = 384 dots”

raster_command.source: Not stated by any seed source: no raster command is named for the SRP-332III (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites).

raster_max_rows.source: Not stated by any seed source: no raster limit is named for the SRP-332III (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites).

code_pages.source: Not stated by any seed source: no code page is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). Receipts print as raster; code pages serve only the §2.1 text fallback (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2).

auto_cutter.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Bixolon, SRP-330III specification sheet, https://bixoloneu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/SS_SRP-330III_EN_JAN25_V1.pdf: an auto-cutter, a 24 V drawer port, and the partition

cut_command.source: Not stated by any seed source: an auto-cutter is named at most, never which GS V cut it honours (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). 1.7.4's partial cut is a baseline, not this device's fact (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a).

cut_feed_rows.source: Not stated by any seed source: no feed before the cut is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). It is measured on the device: crate::escpos records why no feed is emitted yet (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.5).

status_protocol.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Bixolon, SRP-33xIII user manual, https://bixolon.com/_upload/manual/Manual_User_SRP-33xIII_ENG_V1.00.pdf: “Bixolon's command manual documents DLE EOT and network printing on port 9100, though not, in so many words, status over Ethernet”. Unknown until the gate confirms it

drawer_port_volts.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3, citing Bixolon, SRP-330III specification sheet, https://bixoloneu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/SS_SRP-330III_EN_JAN25_V1.pdf: an auto-cutter, a 24 V drawer port, and the partition

drawer_pulse.source: Not stated by any seed source: no pin or timing is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.3 and the documents it cites). The pin is the drawer's property and the timings its solenoid's (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.5; ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a).

supports_raster_arabic.source: A qualification result rather than a datasheet fact: nobody has printed the Arabic goldens on this device (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a; milestone 5.8.3).
